learning_objective: ☀️ Uncover the biochemical magic of how plants capture sunlight and transform water and carbon dioxide into life-sustaining sugar and oxygen!

key_vocabulary.hindi_meaning: हरितलवक (कोशिकांग जहाँ प्रकाश संश्लेषण होता है)
प्रकाश तंत्र (वर्णकों का समूह जो प्रकाश ऊर्जा को पकड़ता है)
केल्विन चक्र (अप्रकाशिक अभिक्रिया जिसमें CO2 से शर्करा बनती है)

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Takes place in the chloroplasts. The membrane system (grana/thylakoids) is responsible for trapping light and making ATP/NADPH (Light Reaction). The fluid stroma is where enzymatic reactions synthesize sugar (Dark Reaction).

Light energy is absorbed by Photosystem II (PSII) and Photosystem I (PSI). Electrons get excited and jump through an electron transport system. Water is split (photolysis) to provide electrons, releasing Oxygen as a byproduct. ATP and NADPH are formed.

Occurs in the stroma and doesn't require direct light (but needs the ATP/NADPH from the light reaction). The enzyme RuBisCO fixes CO2 into a 3-carbon compound (PGA). Eventually, this cycle produces glucose.

Plants in dry, hot climates (like maize and sugarcane) use this to save water. They have a special 'Kranz anatomy' (bundle sheath cells). They fix CO2 into a 4-carbon acid first, avoiding the wasteful process of photorespiration entirely.

RuBisCO has a flaw: it can bind to Oxygen instead of CO2 when O2 levels are high and CO2 is low. When this happens, it burns energy (ATP) and releases CO2 without making any sugar. It's a wasteful process in C3 plants.

fun_activity.title: 🌈 The Hidden Colors of Leaves
fun_activity.instructions: Leaves aren't just green! They contain Chlorophyll a (bright green), Chlorophyll b (yellow-green), Xanthophylls (yellow), and Carotenoids (orange). During autumn, chlorophyll breaks down first, revealing the beautiful hidden yellow and orange pigments!

exam_tips: 📌 Photosystem I (PSI) has a reaction center that absorbs light at 700 nm (P700), while PSII absorbs at 680 nm (P680).

📌 Distinguish between Cyclic and Non-cyclic photophosphorylation. Cyclic only involves PSI and makes only ATP. Non-cyclic (Z-scheme) involves both PSI and PSII and makes both ATP and NADPH, plus Oxygen.
📌 Law of Limiting Factors (Blackman, 1905): If a process is affected by multiple factors, its rate is determined by the factor nearest to its minimal value (the slowest step).
quick_recap: ⭐ Oxygen released during photosynthesis comes from the splitting of Water (H2O), not from Carbon Dioxide.
⭐ PEPcase (Phosphoenolpyruvate carboxylase) is the primary CO2 acceptor enzyme in the mesophyll cells of C4 plants.
⭐ The Calvin cycle requires 18 ATP and 12 NADPH molecules to produce one molecule of glucose.
